caseNameFull: Hill v. Lockhart, Director, Arkansas Department of Correction

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 470 U. S. 1049.] Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed further herein in forma pauperis granted. Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Jack T. Lassiter, Esquire, of Little Rock, Ark., be appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner in this case.
